property_summary: For any caller address, calling setL1BlockValues on the reference contract always reverts unless the caller is the mutable depositorAccount (so non-equal to the hardcoded DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT when depositorAccount differs); the mutant which checks the constant DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT instead allows the hardcoded address to succeed and thus violates the invariant that calls from arbitrary addresses (including the hardcoded one when depositorAccount is different) cannot set L1 values — the fuzzer can pick depositorAccount and caller to expose the difference.
change_summary: Replace the require guard to check against the declared constant DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT instead of depositorAccount, enabling the hardcoded address to set values.
